mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concepts(user_id, graph_category, name, score) VALUES(#{userId}, #{category}, #{name}, #{score})

INSERT INTO concepts(user_id, graph_category, name, score) VALUES
(#{c.userId}, #{c.category}, #{c.name}, #{c.score})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, graph_category as category, name, score FROM concepts WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id as userId, graph_category as category, name, score FROM concepts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND graph_category = #{category}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM concepts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND graph_category = #{category}
mapper.update: UPDATE concepts SET graph_category = #{newName} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND graph_category = #{oldName}
